name: 84321 · Logan, UT
findings: ZIP 84321 (Logan) has 157 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84321 (Logan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84321 (Logan) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
